issues.evidence: Body line '本月只决定下一轮试点的排班范围。' sits at 20px below a 58px title, leaving a large empty gap between title and divider; the sole takeaway reads as low-emphasis body text on the cover.
issues.suggestedChange: Increase the body line to 22–24px and tighten vertical spacing so the decision statement reads as the key message.

issues.evidence: Bar chart at 62,192–898,478 titled 阅览室贡献最多晚间到访: the four bars (48, 26, 11, 7) are all rendered in the same single blue (#244F96) with no series differentiation or baseline emphasis, and the largest bar tops at only ~352 px while the frame reaches ~478 px, leaving the chart reading as a plain ranking rather than supporting the 排班决策. Additionally the y-axis has no scale ticks, so the 48 vs 26 ratio cannot be verified visually.
issues.suggestedChange: Add y-axis tick labels/scale or a data table, and use color to separate 阅览室 from other areas so the 22-person gap is legible; consider a secondary annotation tying the 48-value to the staffing implication.

issues.evidence: 标签栏与说明文字的行间垂直间距较大，标签和说明文字对不齐，版面略显松散。
issues.suggestedChange: 将标签与对应说明文字的对齐方式统一为垂直居中或顶部对齐，使两行内容视觉上更紧凑。

issues.evidence: 右下角页码“03 / 04”字号为13pt、颜色为#465A72，在#F7F9FD背景上对比度偏低。
issues.suggestedChange: 可以适当加深页码颜色或略微增大字号，以提升可读性。

issues.evidence: 正文三列各仅一行（如“记录晚间客流。”），却占用从 y≈231 到 y≈478 的高文本框，导致标题与时间轴之间、正文下方出现大片空白，三列信息密度极低。
issues.suggestedChange: 压缩正文文本框高度或增加本周的具体动作/指标行，平衡时间轴与页脚之间的留白。

issues.evidence: 三列标签字号 23、颜色 244F96，正文 20、颜色 465A72，层级差异仅约 3pt，视觉上标签与正文几乎同权。
issues.suggestedChange: 加大标签与正文字号差或改用不同字重/颜色，使“第 1/2/3 周”成为明确主层级。

issues.evidence: 标题左边缘与时间轴起点 rect-5（x=62）对齐，但标题上方装饰线 rect-2 仅宽 54，视觉上短于标题“分三周跟踪试点”的宽度，形成顶部悬空短线。
issues.suggestedChange: 将装饰线加宽至与标题基线宽度协调，或取消短线改用其他层级标识。
